derivations.quote: Let $P_i=\prod_{j<i}s_j$ be the product of the lengths before axis $i$, and $\mu_i=P_i^{-1}\pmod{s_i}$.

Define $\Phi:\mathbb C[x]/(x^S-1)\to\mathbb C[x_1,\dots,x_d]/(x_i^{s_i}-1)$ by $x\mapsto\prod_i x_i^{\mu_i}$, with one variable $x_i$ per axis. Since $s_i\mid S$, each $x_i^{\mu_iS}=1$, so $\Phi$ respects $x^S=1$ and defines an algebra map.

Then $\Phi(x^k)=1$ exactly when $s_i\mid\mu_ik$ for every $i$; as $\mu_i$ is a unit modulo $s_i$ this means $s_i\mid k$ for every $i$, and as the $s_i$ are pairwise coprime, $S\mid k$. So the image of $x$ has order $S$ and its $S$ powers are distinct. The target has exactly $S$ monomials, so the powers run through all of them exactly once. Hence $\Phi$ is an isomorphism and preserves [Cyclic convolution](convolution.md).
Write $k=\sum_ja_jP_j$ in mixed radix with digits $0\le a_j<s_j$. The axis-$i$ coordinate $b_i$ of $\Phi(x^k)$ is $\mu_ik\bmod s_i$.
Terms with $j>i$ vanish modulo $s_i$, since $s_i$ divides $P_j$, and $\mu_iP_i\equiv1$ modulo $s_i$. Hence $b_i=a_i+\mu_i\sum_{j<i}a_jP_j\pmod{s_i}$, which depends only on lower-index digits.

Reversing the axis order to $(a_1,\dots,a_d)$ puts controls first. Update targets for $i=d,d-1,\dots,1$, so no lower-index control has yet changed when axis $i$ is updated. Each update is a prefix-controlled cyclic shift of the valid interval $[0,s_i)$ and the identity on $[s_i,t_i)$, so zero padding stays zero.

Axes have $\ell$ or $\ell-1$ address bits; for unequal widths, move the longer axis's leading bit aside, swap the equal-width remainder, and restore the bit, adding fixed linear passes. Reversing $d$ axes takes $O(d^2)$ adjacent swaps, so reordering dominates the $O(dTp)$ shifts and $O(Tp)$ scans.

symbols.name: axis length
symbols.meaning: The length of cyclic axis i of the source; the lengths are pairwise coprime.
symbols.quote: Let $d$ be the number of axes, $i$ index them, and the lengths $s_i$ be pairwise coprime (unrelated to $s_i$ on the chirp page).

symbols.name: prefix product
symbols.meaning: The product of the lengths s_j with j<i.
symbols.quote: Let $P_i=\prod_{j<i}s_j$ be the product of the lengths before axis $i$, and $\mu_i=P_i^{-1}\pmod{s_i}$.

symbols.name: axis exponent
symbols.meaning: The inverse of P_i modulo s_i, used as the exponent of x_i.
symbols.quote: Let $P_i=\prod_{j<i}s_j$ be the product of the lengths before axis $i$, and $\mu_i=P_i^{-1}\pmod{s_i}$.

symbols.name: Chinese-remainder map
symbols.meaning: The algebra isomorphism from the cyclic ring of length S to the product of cyclic axes.
symbols.quote: Define $\Phi:\mathbb C[x]/(x^S-1)\to\mathbb C[x_1,\dots,x_d]/(x_i^{s_i}-1)$ by $x\mapsto\prod_i x_i^{\mu_i}$, with one variable $x_i$ per axis.

symbols.name: axis variable
symbols.meaning: The polynomial variable of axis i, with x_i^{s_i}=1.
symbols.quote: Define $\Phi:\mathbb C[x]/(x^S-1)\to\mathbb C[x_1,\dots,x_d]/(x_i^{s_i}-1)$ by $x\mapsto\prod_i x_i^{\mu_i}$, with one variable $x_i$ per axis.

symbols.name: coefficient index
symbols.meaning: A single coefficient index, an exponent of x, not an index tuple.
symbols.quote: In this page $k$ is a single coefficient index, an exponent of $x$, not an index tuple as on the multidimensional-transform page.

symbols.name: mixed-radix digit
symbols.meaning: The digit of k in position j of its mixed-radix expression, with 0 <= a_j < s_j.
symbols.quote: Write $k=\sum_ja_jP_j$ in mixed radix with digits $0\le a_j<s_j$.

symbols.name: axis coordinate
symbols.meaning: The coordinate in axis i of the image of x^k.
symbols.quote: The axis-$i$ coordinate $b_i$ of $\Phi(x^k)$ is $\mu_ik\bmod s_i$.

symbols.name: address bits
symbols.meaning: The number of address bits of an axis of length r, with r = 2^ell.
symbols.quote: Pad axis $i$ with zero records to a length $t_i\in\{r/2,r\}$, where $r=2^\ell$ is the record length, so $\ell$ is the number of address bits of an axis of length $r$.

symbols.name: padded record count
symbols.meaning: The number of padded records, the product of the axis lengths t_i.
symbols.quote: Let $T=\prod_it_i$ be the number of padded records, each of $O(p)$ bits (with $p$ as on the fixed-point page).

symbols.name: interchange exponent
symbols.meaning: A fixed exponent below 1 in the chunk-interchange time bound.
symbols.quote: Let $V=Tp$ be the stream volume and $\tau<1$ a fixed exponent.

symbols.name: axis index
symbols.meaning: The index of an axis, from 1 to d.
symbols.quote: Let $d$ be the number of axes, $i$ index them, and the lengths $s_i$ be pairwise coprime (unrelated to $s_i$ on the chirp page).

symbols.name: padded axis length
symbols.meaning: The length of axis i after zero padding, either r/2 or r.
symbols.quote: Pad axis $i$ with zero records to a length $t_i\in\{r/2,r\}$, where $r=2^\ell$ is the record length, so $\ell$ is the number of address bits of an axis of length $r$.
